The person behind the index

I build software that questions its own foundation.

I'm Chris Kluis. For nearly two decades I've worked the seam where product, marketing, and go-to-market meet in B2B SaaS. I took an enterprise software company from on-prem to SaaS to acquisition, and co-founded SaaSRock. Back then I was the idea guy; a developer built everything.

The tooling changed that. Everything here is me building the ideas I used to have to give away, and an open invitation for every other idea person to start experimenting too.
